summary: Frontend-only verification of the redesigned seafarer eligibility gate on the Matches tab. Logged in as seeker +919746835595 (OTP 123456), opened Matches, and validated DOM order, wording, styling and testids of data-testid=eligibility-gate. All requested structural/wording requirements PASS: single stacked box (registration-section and share-section share identical x=217 and width=672, registration y=620 above share y=830, so not side-by-side), registration section first with computed text-decoration 'line-through' on the ₹100 span plus yellow 'Skip it with a free share below ↓' and working 'Pay ₹100 & register' button (pay-register-btn), an 'OR' divider positioned between the two sections (y=798), then share-section with bold green heading 'Simply Share for Free — Share & Visibility' (computed color rgb(37,211,102), font-weight 800) and a RECOMMENDED badge, Groups 0/2 and Contacts 0/10 counters, and buttons share-group-btn ('Share to group'), share-contact-btn ('Send to contact') and claim-free-btn labelled 'Share more to unlock' (correctly disabled while not eligible). Screenshot captured. No real share/payment was triggered. No console errors.

issues: Inner content is capped at max-w-2xl (672px) inside a 1536px-wide gate card, leaving ~810px of empty space on the right — looks unbalanced on desktop; consider centering (mx-auto) the max-w-2xl block or widening it.

Disabled 'Share more to unlock' button (claim-free-btn) renders as dark orange with dim white text (disabled:opacity-40) — low contrast; a muted/neutral disabled style with clearer text would read better.

action_items: Optional polish only: center or widen the max-w-2xl inner block inside the eligibility gate on desktop; improve contrast of the disabled claim-free-btn.
critical_code_review_comments: EligibilityGate share() opens a WhatsApp window after POST /referral/share even if the POST fails (catch swallows the error) — counters can desync from server state; consider surfacing the failure.
Matches.jsx is growing large (gate + cards + near matches in one file); consider extracting EligibilityGate into its own component file.
